Figure 1:Robot policies morph with changing interaction contexts.(a) A single manipulation task involves operations with different
perceptual and control demands.
(b) Existing robot policies use one fixed parameter configuration across
contexts, requiring shared parameters to reconcile competing demands.
(c) MorphAct generates context-dependent updates for the vision–language
and action modules, dynamically adjusting policy parameters as interactions unfold.
